blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: External-eye photography captures clinically relevant periocular anatomy at low acquisition cost, yet no large-scale standardized resource exists for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representations. We introduce a 4.35-million-image Standardized External-Eye Corpus (SEEC) derived from fourteen heterogeneous public face datasets, together with a benchmark for external-eye representation learning. For evaluation, we provide held-out evaluation distributions, landmark-annotated anatomical probe sets, and clinical disease-classification experiments spanning ptosis, thyroid eye disease, and craniofacial syndromes. We evaluate representations at two complementary levels: (a) the representation level, by assessing embedding geometry across multiple data distributions, and (b) the functional level, by assessing anatomical recovery, out-of-distribution anatomical transfer, and disease classification. Our models include ResNet-101 and ViT-B encoders pretrained using InfoNCE, VICReg, and LeJEPA objectives and compared with DINOv2 and MAE. Our results indicate that representation-level and functional-level evaluations are dissociable: broader embedding-space utilization does not consistently correspond to anatomical transfer or disease-classification performance, and no single encoder is universally optimal. Domain-specific external-eye encoders outperform DINOv2 and MAE on cross-dataset anatomical transfer despite being pretrained at substantially smaller scale, while external-eye-pretrained ViT models match or outperform these general-purpose baselines on frozen disease-classification probes. We release benchmark code, evaluation scripts, and preprocessing pipelines to reproduce SEEC at https://monkeygobah.github.io/seec-project/
blocks.zh: 外眼摄影以低收购成本获取临床上相关的腹膜解剖学,然而并没有大规模的标准化资源来评价自我监督的外眼表现. 我们采用了由14个不同的公共脸谱数据集衍生出来的435万个图像标准化的外眼公司(SEEC),以及外眼代表性学习的基准。 对于评价,我们提供被搁置的评价分布、标志性附加说明的解剖探测器、以及临床疾病分类实验,包括硬化、甲状腺眼疾病和颅骨综合征。 我们评价两个互补层次的表述:(a) 表述水平,通过评估多种数据分布的嵌入几何学;(b) 功能水平,通过评估解剖恢复、分配外解剖转移和疾病分类。 我们的模型包括ResNet-101和ViT-B编码器,使用InfoNCE、VICReg和LeJEPA目标进行预训,并与DINOv2和MAE进行比较。 我们的结果表明,代表级别和职能级别评价是分不开的:更广泛的嵌入空间利用与解剖转移或疾病分类性能不一致,没有单一编码器是普遍最佳的。 特定领域外眼编码器在跨数据集解剖转移方面超过了DINOv2和MAE,尽管其预先训练的规模大大小,而外眼前置维T模型则与冷冻疾病分类探测器上的这些通用基线相匹配或超过其绩效。 我们在https://monkeygobah.github.io/seec-project/发布基准代码、评价脚本和预处理管道,以复制SEEC。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Unlike internal ocular imaging modalities such as fundus photography or optical coherence tomography, external-eye photography captures the visible anatomy of the eyelids, palpebral fissures, canthi, iris, sclera, brows, and surrounding periocular soft tissue. These structures are clinically relevant for documenting and assessing conditions such as ptosis, thyroid eye disease, facial nerve palsy, craniofacial anomalies, trauma, and postoperative outcomes ( Ural et al., 2016 ; Barman Kakil and Arslan, 2025 ; Kumar Jr et al., 2024 ; Theng et al., 2021 ) . More broadly, recent work suggests that external-eye photographs may encode biomarkers of systemic health with relevance in diabetes, kidney, and liver disease ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Babenko et al., 2023 ) . The externally visible eye therefore provides a low-cost, camera-accessible anatomical interface that may support scalable biomarker discovery and systemic health monitoring ( Babenko et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 与Fundus摄影或光学一致性拓扑摄影等内视成像模式不同,外视摄影能捕捉到眼皮的可见解剖学,帕氏裂纹,罐头,虹膜,sclera,眉毛,以及周围的心肌软组织. 这些结构在临床上与记录和评估诸如硬化、甲状腺眼疾病、面部神经麻痹、颅骨异常、创伤和手术后结果等情况相关(Ural等人,2016年;Barman Kakil和Arslan,2025年;Kumar)。 Jr.等人,2024年;Theng等人,2021年). 更广义地说,最近的工作表明,外眼照片可能将系统健康的生物标志与糖尿病、肾病和肝病相关联(Zhu等人,2025年;Babenko等人,2023年)。 因此,外部可见眼提供了一个低成本、相机无障碍的解剖接口,可能有助于可扩展生物标记器的发现和系统的健康监测(Babenko等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning has enabled transferable visual representations to be learned from large unlabeled image collections, and ophthalmic foundation-model development has benefited from large modality-specific datasets in retinal fundus photography, optical coherence tomography, and related device-based imaging ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Chia et al., 2024 ) . Comparable large-scale resources for external-eye representation learning remain limited. Existing face datasets were developed for identity recognition, facial attributes, or image generation rather than standardized modeling of external-eye anatomy ( Liu et al., 2015 ; Cao et al., 2018 ; Karras et al., 2019 ) . Dedicated iris and periocular datasets have generally been designed for biometric recognition or specialized eye-analysis tasks and are considerably smaller than contemporary pretraining corpora ( Proena and Alexandre, 2005 ; Proenca et al., 2010 ; Padole and Proenca, 2012 ; Zanlorensi et al., 2022 ; Nguyen et al., 2021 ; Tiong et al., 2019 ) . As a result, no existing resource provides the combination of scale, standardized external-eye anatomy, and evaluation structure needed to study general-purpose external-eye representations. Addressing this problem requires both a large, standardized pretraining corpus and a benchmark capable of assessing the quality, robustness, and transferability of external-eye representations across diverse datasets and downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习使可转移的视觉表现能够从大型无标签图像集中学习,眼球基础模型的开发得益于视网膜基金摄影、光学一致性成像以及相关设备成像中的大型模式专用数据集(周等人,2023年;Chia等人,2024年)。 用于外眼代表性学习的可比大规模资源仍然有限。 现有面部数据集是为身份识别,面部属性,或图像生成而开发的,而非外眼解剖学的标准化模型(刘等人,2015年;曹等人,2018年;Karras等人,2019年). 专门化的虹膜和透视数据集一般是为生物识别或专门眼分析任务而设计的,其规模远小于当代培养前的蝎子(Proena and Alexandre,2005年;Proenca等人,2010年;Padole and Proenca,2012年;Zanlorensi等人,2022年;Nguyen等人,2021年;Tiong等人,2019年)。 因此,没有现有资源提供研究一般目的外眼表述所需的规模、标准化外眼解剖学和评价结构的组合。 要解决这一问题,既需要大型、标准化的预先培训教材,也需要一个能够评估不同数据集和下游任务中外眼表现的质量、稳健性和可转移性的基准。

blocks.en: Evaluating these representations therefore requires moving beyond any single downstream endpoint. Accordingly, here we consider the following three complementary questions: 1. how do learned representations occupy the embedding space across in-distribution and domain-shifted image distributions? 2. do frozen representations preserve fine-grained periocular anatomy, and does this anatomical information transfer across datasets? 3. do the learned representations support clinically relevant disease classification? To this end, we evaluate representations at two complementary levels. At the representation level, we characterize embedding geometry across held-out and domain-shifted evaluation distributions. At the functional level, we evaluate anatomical landmark recovery, cross-dataset anatomical transfer, and clinical disease classification.
blocks.zh: 因此,评估这些表述需要超越任何单一的下游终点。 因此,我们在此审议以下三个补充问题: 1. 所学表现如何占据分布式和域位转换图像分布的嵌入空间? 2. 被冻结的表示是否保留了精细的透视解剖学,这种解剖信息是否跨越数据集传输? 3. 学到的表述是否支持临床相关的疾病分类? 为此,我们评价两个相辅相成的级别上的陈述。 在代表一级,我们描述的是,在搁置和域间转移的评价分布中嵌入几何。 在功能层面,我们评价解剖学里程碑性恢复,跨数据集解剖转移,以及临床疾病分类.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First , we introduce a large-scale Standardized External-Eye Corpus ( SEEC ) containing 4.35 million aligned unilateral periocular crops derived from fourteen public facial image sources, with standardized preprocessing and fixed pretraining and evaluation subsets. Second , we define a multi-axis benchmark designed to test whether external-eye representations preserve useful geometry and anatomy, transfer across datasets, and allow for clinically relevant downstream prediction. Third , we establish reference baselines across contrastive, redundancy-reduction, and JEPA-style self-supervised objectives using ResNet-101 and ViT-B/16 backbones, with comparisons to DINOv2 and MAE. We additionally release benchmark code, preprocessing and reconstruction pipelines, train/evaluation splits, model training configurations, and evaluation scripts; processed images are released directly where source terms permit redistribution.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,我们引入了大规模标准化的外眼公司(SEC),包含来自14个公共面部图像来源的435万个对齐的单边腹膜作物,并有标准化的预处理和固定的预培训和评价子集. 第二,我们确定一个多轴基准,旨在测试外眼表达是否保存有用的几何学和解剖学,跨数据集传输,并允许临床相关的下游预测. 第三,我们利用ResNet-101和VIT-B/16主干线,确定对比性、冗余减少和JEPA式自我监督目标的参考基线,并与DINOv2和MAE进行比较。 此外,我们还发布基准代码、预处理和重建管道、火车/评估拆分、模型培训配置和评价脚本;在源词允许重新分配的情况下,直接发布处理过的图像。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep learning and the external eye. External-eye images have been used for a growing range of clinical computer-vision tasks in oculoplastics, ophthalmology, and craniofacial medicine. Prior work includes blepharoptosis detection from periocular photographs ( Hung et al., 2021 ; Shu et al., 2024 ; Abascal Azanza et al., 2023 ) , thyroid eye disease assessment using external photographs or orbital imaging ( Karlin et al., 2023 ; Moon et al., 2022 ; Alkhadrawi et al., 2024 ; Han et al., 2025 ) , and eyelid-lesion localization and classification ( Li et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Hui et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 深学与外眼. 外眼影像被应用到越来越多的临床计算机视觉任务中,用于八面体、眼科和颅骨医学。 以往的工作包括:通过透视照片(Hung等人,2021年;Shu等人,2024年;Abascal Azaza等人,2023年);利用外部照片或轨道成像对甲状腺眼疾病进行评估(Karlin等人,2023年;Moon等人,2022年;Alkhadrawi等人,2024年;Han等人,2025年),以及眼皮球局部化和分类(Li等人,2022年;Lee等人,2023年;Hui等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Oculomics and ophthalmic representation learning. Oculomics studies ocular and periocular phenotypes as biomarkers of systemic, neurologic, developmental, and environmental health ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Much of this literature has focused on internal ocular imaging, particularly retinal fundus photography and optical coherence tomography ( Poplin et al., 2018 ; Ting and Wong, 2018 ) . These modalities have also become important for ophthalmic foundation-model development; RETFound, for example, used self-supervised pretraining on 1.6 million retinal images and was adapted across multiple downstream disease tasks ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) . External-eye oculomics has likewise demonstrated clinically relevant signal. Babenko et al. developed supervised deep-learning systems to predict diabetic retinal disease, HbA1c, and multiple systemic biomarkers directly from external-eye photographs ( Babenko et al., 2022 ; Babenko et al., 2023 ) . These external-eye studies focused on end-to-end prediction of predefined clinical endpoints rather than large-scale representation learning intended for reuse across tasks.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤学与眼科表现学. 蛋白质组学研究了作为系统、神经、发育和环境健康的生物标志的眼球和心肌类(Zhu等人,2025年)。 这些文献多以内视成像为主,尤其是视网膜基金摄影和光学一致性成像(Poplin等人,2018年;Ting和Wong,2018年). 这些模式对于眼科基础模型的发展也变得很重要;例如,RETFoud在160万个视网膜图像上使用自我监督的预训,并经过多个下游疾病任务的调整(周等人,2023年). 外眼八聚体也表现出临床相关信号。 巴本科等编. 开发了有监督的深入学习系统,直接从外眼照片中预测糖尿病视网膜疾病HbA1c和多种系统生物标记(Babenko等人,2022年;Babenko等人,2023年)。 这些外眼研究侧重于对预先确定的临床终点的端到端预测,而不是旨在跨任务再利用的大规模表达学习.

blocks.en: Ocular and periocular datasets. Dedicated ocular and periocular datasets such as UBIRIS.v2, UBIPr, VISOB, and UFPR-Periocular have primarily been designed for iris recognition, periocular biometrics, verification, and related recognition tasks ( Proena and Alexandre, 2005 ; Proenca et al., 2010 ; Padole and Proenca, 2012 ; Zanlorensi et al., 2022 ; Nguyen et al., 2021 ; Tiong et al., 2019 ) . Other eye-image resources target specialized acquisition settings. For example, TEyeD contains millions of images from head-mounted eye trackers for gaze estimation, segmentation, and geometric eye modeling ( Fuhl et al., 2021 ) . Large facial datasets such as CelebA, VGGFace2, and FFHQ also contain substantial periocular content, although they were originally developed for full-face recognition, facial attributes, and generative modeling ( Liu et al., 2015 ; Cao et al., 2018 ; Karras et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 视星等和透视数据集. UBIRIS.v2、UBIPr、VISOB和UFPR-Periocular等专用显微光和显微光数据集主要用于虹膜识别、显微光生物鉴别、核查和相关识别任务(Proena和Alexandre,2005年;Proenca等人,2010年;Padole和Proenca,2012年;Zanlorensi等人,2022年;Nguyen等人,2021年;Tiong等人,2019年)。 其他眼像资源则针对专门的获取设置. 举例来说, Teye D包含数百万来自头架眼跟踪器的图像,用于视线估计、分解和几何眼模型(Fuhl等人,2021年)。 CelebA,VGGFace2,FFHQ等大型面部数据集也包含大量的透视内容,尽管它们最初是为全面识别,面部属性,以及基因模型开发而来的(刘等人,2015年;曹等人,2018年;Karras等人,2019年).

blocks.en: 3 SEEC Construction
blocks.zh: 3 SEEC 建筑工程

blocks.en: SEEC was constructed from fourteen heterogeneous publicly available facial image datasets containing visible ocular and periocular anatomy Ma et al. (2015) ; Ma et al. (2021) ; Lakshmi et al. (2021) ; de Oliveira Junior and Eduardo Thomaz (2005) ; Goldstein (2017) ; Zhang et al. (2017) ; Venkatesh et al. (2020) ; Rothe et al. (2018) ; Liu et al. (2015) ; Bansal et al. (2017) ; Karras et al. (2019) ; Cao et al. (2018) . The construction pipeline consisted of sequential preprocessing and curation stages including image deduplication, face detection and landmark-based alignment, manual periocular annotation, dataset-specific CNN-based filtering, bilateral periocular cropping, and division into unilateral eye crops. All retained unilateral images were standardized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels to form the primary SEEC corpus, with a higher-resolution subset additionally standardized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. Figure 1 A summarizes the construction pipeline.
blocks.zh: SEEC是利用十四套可公开获取的面部图像数据集构建的,这些数据集包含可见的视力和穿透性解剖学Ma等人(2015年);Ma等人(2021年);Lakshmi等人(2021年);de Oliveira Junior和Eduardo Thomaz(2005年);Goldstein(2017年); 张等人(2017年);文卡泰什等人(2020年);罗特等人(2018年);刘等人(2015年);班萨尔等人(2017年);卡尔拉斯等人(2019年);曹等人(2018年). 施工管道包括相继的预处理和整治阶段,包括图像分解、面部探测和基于地标的对齐、手动腹腔注解、针对CNN的数据集过滤、双边腹腔收割以及分裂成单边眼力作物。 所有保留的单边图像都被标准化为224×224×224×时224像素,形成主SEEC体,高分辨率子集被进一步标准化为512×512×时512×时512像素. 图1 A汇总了施工管道。

blocks.en: 3.1 Source Dataset Compilation
blocks.zh: 3.1 源数据集汇编

blocks.en: Images were aggregated from fourteen publicly available facial image datasets: CFD, CFD-I, CFD-MR, Tufts, FEI, FIML, UTKFace, MORPH, WikiFace, CelebA, UMD Faces, IMDB-WIKI, FFHQ, and VGGFace2 Ma et al. (2015) ; Ma et al. (2021) ; Lakshmi et al. (2021) ; de Oliveira Junior and Eduardo Thomaz (2005) ; Goldstein (2017) ; Zhang et al. (2017) ; Venkatesh et al. (2020) ; Rothe et al. (2018) ; Liu et al. (2015) ; Bansal et al. (2017) ; Karras et al. (2019) ; Cao et al. (2018) . These sources span controlled facial-image datasets, celebrity image collections, and large-scale face-recognition datasets and provide variation in pose, illumination, image quality, resolution, acquisition setting, age, sex, and race/ethnicity. All datasets were obtained and processed in accordance with their source licensing restrictions (Supplementary Table 9 ). No modifications were made to the source images before preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 从14个公开的面部图像数据集汇总了图像:CFD,CFD-I,CFD-MR,Tufts,FEI,FIML,UTKFace,MORPH,Wikiface,CelebA,UMD Faces,IMDB-WIKI,FFHQ,以及VGGFace2 Ma等人(2015年);Ma等人(2021年);Lakshmi等人(2021年);de Oliveira Junior和Eduardo Thomaz(2005年);Goldstein(2017年); 张等人(2017年);文卡泰什等人(2020年);罗特等人(2018年);刘等人(2015年);班萨尔等人(2017年);卡尔拉斯等人(2019年);曹等人(2018年). 这些来源覆盖了有控制的面部图像数据集、名人图像集和大规模面部识别数据集,并提供了姿势、照明、图像质量、分辨率、获取设定、年龄、性别和种族/族裔差异。 所有数据集都是根据其来源许可证限制(补充表9)获得和处理的。 在预处理前未对源图像进行修改。

blocks.en: 3.2 Image Deduplication and Face Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.2 图像复制和面部对齐

blocks.en: An MD5 hash was computed for each image file within each source dataset to identify and remove exact duplicate images. For all remaining images, facial landmarks were detected using the MediaPipe FaceMesh model Kartynnik et al. (2019) . Images in which no face or multiple faces were detected were excluded from further processing. For images containing a single detected face, facial landmarks were used to standardize image orientation. Images were rotated such that the line connecting the soft-tissue nasion and midpoint of the hairline was vertically aligned, corresponding to MediaPipe landmark indices 6 and 10. The required rotation angle was computed from these landmarks and applied to the full image prior to subsequent periocular-region extraction and filtering.
blocks.zh: 在每个源数据集内为每个图像文件计算了一个MD5 hash,以识别和删除准确的重复图像. 对于所有剩余图像,使用MediaPipe FaceMesh模型Kartynnik等人(2019年)检测到了面部标志. 没有发现面孔或多面孔的图像被排除在进一步处理之外。 对于包含单个检测到的面孔的图像,使用了面部标志来规范图像导向. 图像被旋转,从而连接软质问题鼻线和发线中点的线条垂直对齐,与MediaPipe标志性指数6和10相对应. 所需旋转角度是从这些地标计算出来的,并应用于随后的透视区域提取和过滤之前的全部图像。

blocks.en: 3.3 Periocular Image Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 透视图像注释

blocks.en: For each of the nine datasets requiring automated periocular filtering (CelebA, FIML, IMDB-WIKI, MORPH, UMD Faces, UTKFace, WikiFace, FFHQ, and VGGFace2), 2,500 images were randomly sampled and manually labeled for periocular visibility. Images were classified as periocular (positive) when both of the following criteria were satisfied: (1) both palpebral fissures were visible as distinct eyelid apertures, and (2) at least three of the four medial and lateral canthi were identifiable. Images were classified as non-periocular (negative) if either criterion was not satisfied. Negative examples therefore included images with periocular occlusion from hair, hands, or other objects; extreme head pose resulting in only one visible eye; image cropping that excluded part of the periocular region; or image degradation such as blur or compression that prevented reliable identification of eyelid structures.
blocks.zh: 对于需要自动穿透滤波的9个数据集(CelebA,FIML,IMDB-WIKI,MORPH,UMD Faces,UTKFace,Wikiface,FFHQ,和VGGFace2),2500个图像被随机抽取,并手动标注了穿透可见度. 当符合以下两种标准时,图像被归类为穿透性(阳性): (1) 双胸裂缝明显为明显的眼皮孔径; (2) 四种介质和横向罐头中至少有三种可以识别. 如果不符合任何一项标准,则将图像归类为非表面(负面)。 因此,负面的例子包括:毛发、手或其他物体的穿透性隔离的图像;头部的极端姿势只导致一只可见的眼睛;将部分穿透性区域排除在外的图像裁剪;或图像退化,如模糊或压缩,从而无法可靠地识别眼皮结构。

blocks.en: To assess annotation consistency and refine the negative class, a second blinded grader independently reviewed randomly sampled subsets of images initially labeled as periocular ( n = 100 n=100 ) and non-periocular ( n = 100 n=100 ) from each dataset. In addition, all images initially classified as non-periocular were re-evaluated by the second grader. For classifier development, images classified as periocular by the initial grader were treated as positive, while images classified as non-periocular by both graders were treated as negative. Initially negative images for which the graders disagreed were designated ambiguous (gray). Ambiguous images were excluded from classifier training.
blocks.zh: 为了评估注释一致性和细化负类,第二个失明分级器从每个数据集对最初标注为腹膜(n = 100 n = 100)和非腹膜(n = 100 n = 100)的图像子集进行了独立的随机抽样审查. 此外,所有最初被归类为非单体的图像都被二年级生重新评价. 对于分类器的开发,被初等器归类为过敏的图像被视为阳性,而被两个分级器归类为非过敏的图像则被视为阴性. 最初分级者不同意的负面图像被定为模棱两可(gray). 模糊的图像被排除在分类培训之外。

blocks.en: 3.4 CNN-Based Periocular Filtering
blocks.zh: 3.4 以CNN为基础的腹膜过滤

blocks.en: For datasets in which periocular visibility could not be determined reliably from source structure alone, we trained dataset-specific classifiers and applied source-specific operating thresholds to retain images with adequate periocular visibility.
blocks.zh: 对于仅从源结构无法可靠地确定透视能见度的数据集,我们培训了数据集特定分类器以及应用的源特定操作阈值,以保留具有足够透视能见度的图像.

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Dataset-Specific CNN Training
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 国家 数据集-特定CNN 培训

blocks.en: A separate ResNet-18 convolutional neural network was trained for each of the nine datasets requiring automated periocular filtering. For Tufts and FEI, frontal facial views could be identified using dataset-specific file-naming conventions. Images from CFD, CFD-I, and CFD-MR were sufficiently standardized such that all images remaining after the preceding preprocessing steps satisfied the predefined periocular visibility criteria and were retained. Each ResNet-18 was initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights, and the final fully connected layer was replaced with a two-class output corresponding to periocular and non-periocular images. Training used the positive and negative annotations defined above.
blocks.zh: 为9个需要自动穿透滤波器的数据集的每一个都培训了一个单独的ResNet-18转录神经网络。 对Tufts和FEI来说,可以利用数据集专用文件命名常规来识别面部视图. 来自CFD,CFD-I和CFD-MR的图像已经足够标准化,使得之前的预处理步骤之后剩下的所有图像都符合预定义的透视可见度标准并被保留. 每个ResNet-18都以ImageNet预先调节的权重初始化,最终完全连接的层被替换成一个与透视和非透视图像相对应的双级输出. 培训使用了上述正面和负面说明。

blocks.en: For each dataset, the larger class was randomly subsampled to match the size of the smaller class. The resulting binary classification dataset was divided using stratified sampling into training, validation, and test sets, with 15% assigned to validation and 15% to testing. Input images were resized to 256 pixels and center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels. Random horizontal flipping was used during training, and images were normalized using ImageNet mean and standard deviation values. Models were trained for 10 epochs using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , cosine learning-rate decay, and batch size 32. Model selection was based on validation F1 score.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,对较大的类随机进行子样本,以匹配较小类的大小. 由此产生的二进制分类数据集采用分层抽样方式分为培训、验证和测试组,15%用于验证,15%用于测试。 输入图像被调整为256像素,而中线剪切为224×224\times 224像素. 培训期间使用了随机水平翻转,图像使用ImageNet平均值和标准偏差值实现正常化. 对使用 AdamW 的10 个纪元进行了模型培训,学习率为 1× 10 − 4 1\ Times 10× 4 },体重衰减为 1× 10 − 4 1\ Times 10× 4 }, 余弦学习率衰减, 批号为 32 。 模型选择是基于验证F1分数.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Dataset Filtering and Threshold Selection
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 数据集过滤和阈值选择

blocks.en: The trained dataset-specific classifiers were applied to all corresponding aligned images. For each dataset, thresholds between 0.50 and 0.95 were evaluated on the validation set. The final threshold was defined as the lowest threshold yielding a false-positive rate (FPR) of ≤ 0.025 \leq 0.025 . If no evaluated threshold achieved this criterion, the highest threshold was selected to minimize retention of non-periocular images. Threshold selection was additionally assessed qualitatively by examining predicted probabilities for positive, negative, and ambiguous images and visually reviewing the 25 lowest-confidence images retained as positive at the selected threshold.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的数据集特定分类器适用于所有相应的对齐图像。 对每一数据集的阈值在0.50至0.95之间进行了验证。 最终阈值被定义为最低阈值,得出0.025\leq 0.025的误差率。 如果没有经过评价的阈值达到这一标准,则选择最高阈值以尽量减少对非光圈图像的保留。 此外,还通过审查正、负和模糊图像的预测概率,从视觉上审查在选定阈值上保留为正值的25个最低自信图像,从质量上对阈值选择作了额外评估。

blocks.en: 3.5 Periocular Cropping and Standardization
blocks.zh: 3.5 围垦和标准化

blocks.en: Following CNN-based filtering, retained facial images were cropped to the bilateral periocular region containing the eyes and brows. For each image, the original source image was first rotated using the landmark-derived alignment angle described above, with bicubic interpolation and canvas expansion to preserve the complete rotated image. Bilateral periocular bounding-box coordinates were then defined using MediaPipe Face Mesh landmarks 139 and 383 as the horizontal boundaries and landmarks 104 and 345 as the vertical boundaries, with the resulting box applied to the aligned image to generate the periocular crop.
blocks.zh: 在有线电视新闻网进行过滤后,留存的面部图像被切成含有眼睛和眉毛的双边透视区域。 对于每个图像,最初的源图像首先使用上面描述的地标衍生的对齐角度旋转,有双立体插图和画布扩展,以保存完整的旋转图像. 双边线粒体边框坐标随后被定义为使用MediaPipe Face Mesh地标139和383作为横向边界,而地标104和345作为垂直边界,由此形成的框应用于对齐图像以生成线粒体作物.

blocks.en: Each bilateral periocular crop was subsequently divided into independent right- and left-eye images along a stored vertical split coordinate; when no explicit split coordinate was available, the horizontal midpoint of the crop was used. The left portion of the image was assigned to the subject’s right eye (OD), and the right portion was assigned to the subject’s left eye (OS), consistent with the orientation of frontal facial photographs.
blocks.zh: 随后,每个双边腹膜作物被沿着一个存储的垂直分裂坐标分为独立的右眼和左眼图像;在没有明确的分裂坐标时,使用作物的横向中点。 图像的左部分被分配到主体的右眼(OD),右部分被分配到主体的左眼(OS),与正面面部照片的方向一致.

blocks.en: The resulting unilateral periocular images were standardized to fixed spatial resolutions. All images were resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels using Lanczos resampling to form the primary SEEC corpus for self-supervised pretraining. A higher-resolution subset was additionally generated at 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels using Lanczos resampling. To avoid excessive upsampling, images were included in the high-resolution subset only when the original unilateral periocular crop had a minimum side length of at least 96 pixels before resizing.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的单方面透视图像已标准化为固定空间分辨率。 所有图像被调整为224×224/224\times 224像素,使用Lanczos重印,形成主SEEC程序,用于自我监督的预训. 在512×512 512\times 512像素使用 Lanczos 复刻时额外生成了一个分辨率更高的子集. 为了避免过度的提升采样,只有在最初的单边腹膜作物在重新定型前至少有至少96像素的边长时,图像才被列入高分辨率子集.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark Resources
blocks.zh: 4 基准资源

blocks.en: From the primary SEEC corpus, we define fixed pretraining subsets and held-out open-source evaluation distributions for representation-learning experiments (Table 1 ; Figure 1 C). We additionally use open-source landmark-annotated periocular datasets for anatomical probing and clinical image repositories for domain-shift and disease-classification evaluation.
blocks.zh: 从主要的SEEC程序书中,我们界定了固定的预训子集和用于表现-学习实验的持有的开源评价分布(表1;图1 C)。 此外,我们还使用开源地标说明式透视数据集进行解剖检测和临床图像储存,用于域位转移和疾病分类评估。

blocks.en: Table 1: Dataset components and their roles in the benchmark. † indicates components released directly where source licenses permit redistribution of derived images; for the remaining public-source components, we provide preprocessing code, manifests, crop coordinates, and reconstruction tools to allow authorized users to rebuild the benchmark. ‡ indicates clinical components used under institutional data-use restrictions and not publicly released.
4.1 Pretraining and Open-Source Evaluation Splits
blocks.zh: 4.1 预先培训和开放来源评价

blocks.en: From the primary 224 × 224 224\times 224 SEEC corpus, we define fixed pretraining subsets and held-out open-source evaluation distributions (Table 1 ; Figure 1 C).
blocks.zh: 从初级224x224\时,我们定义了固定的预训子集和持有的开源评价分布(表1;图1 C)。

blocks.en: Pretraining subsets. Fixed subsets of 10,000, 100,000, and 1,000,000 images were sampled from SEEC for controlled self-supervised pretraining experiments evaluating the effect of unlabeled data scale. These subsets are referred to as Pretrain-10K , Pretrain-100K , and Pretrain-1M .
blocks.zh: 预训子集. 从SEC中抽取了10,000,100,000和1,000,000的固定子集图象,用于自控的预训实验,评价无标签数据尺度的效果. 这些子集被称为Pretrain-10K,Pretrain-100K,和Pretrain-1M.

blocks.en: In-distribution evaluation. A held-out set of 421,730 images was sampled from the same source datasets and preprocessing pipeline as the pretraining corpus but excluded from self-supervised training. This set provides an in-distribution evaluation resource without direct image overlap and is referred to as Holdout .
blocks.zh: 分布评估. 一组被搁置的421 730张图像从与预训书相同的源数据集和预处理管道中取样,但被排除在自我监督的培训之外。 本集提供了不直接图像重叠的分布式评价资源,被称为Holdout .

blocks.en: High-resolution open-source evaluation. The 134,969-image high-resolution SEEC subset defined during corpus construction was reserved as an additional held-out evaluation distribution. These images were excluded from self-supervised pretraining and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels for evaluation. This set is referred to as Open-HR .
blocks.zh: 高清开源评价. 人身构造期间定义的134,969-图像高分辨率的SEEC子集被保留作为额外的搁置评价分布. 这些图像被排除在自我监督的预训之外,并调整为224×224×224\time224像素用于评价. 本集被称为Open-HR.

blocks.en: 4.2 Anatomical Landmark Probe Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 解剖学地标探测数据集

blocks.en: For anatomical evaluation, we constructed landmark probe datasets from public CelebA- and CFD-derived periocular segmentation resources by pairing each source image with its semantic mask, splitting the face at the midline into unilateral eye crops, and resizing each crop to 224 × \times 224 pixels Nahass et al. (2025) . Landmark coordinates were derived algorithmically from the available segmentation masks using OpenCV tools with the resized image, consistent with prior work deriving periocular landmarks from anatomically annotated segmentation boundaries Van Brummen et al. (2021) . Because the underlying segmentation masks were annotated according to anatomically defined periocular structures, this method allows for a reproducible mapping from semantic boundaries to landmark coordinates while minimizing further annotation burden. Briefly, an inscribed circle was fit to the iris mask, its center defined the iris centroid, and its superior and inferior points defined the corresponding iris landmarks. Scleral and eyelid superior/inferior landmarks were defined by mask maximum and minimum along the vertical axis passing through the iris centroid, while medial and lateral canthi were defined from the horizontal extrema of the visible scleral region. This procedure yielded nine landmarks per crop: iris centroid, iris superior, iris inferior, sclera superior, sclera inferior, medial canthus, lateral canthus, lid superior, and lid inferior. The resulting landmark probe datasets are referred to as LM-Celeb and LM-CFD .
blocks.zh: 为了解剖学评估,我们从公共的CelebA和CFD衍生的腹膜分解资源中构建了具有里程碑意义的探测数据集,将每个源图像与它的语义面具配对,将中线的面部分割成单眼作物,并将每个作物的大小调整到224×时的224像素Nahass等人(2025年)。 Landmark坐标是从使用OpenCV工具的可用分解口罩算法推导而来,其图像尺寸已调整,这与先前从解剖学上附加说明的分解边界Van Brummen等人(2021年)衍生出来的地铁地标的工作是一致的。 由于基本的分解口罩是根据解剖定义的透视结构附加说明的,这种方法允许从语义边界到地标坐标进行可复制的绘图,同时将进一步的注释负担降到最低. 简而言之,一个被刻画的圆圈适合虹膜,其中心定义了虹膜中心,它的优劣点则定义了相应的虹膜地标. 通过虹膜中间体的垂直轴上,用面具最大和最小度定义了Scleral和眼皮上位/地标,而介质和横向罐头则从可见的螺纹区域的水平外观来定义。 这个程序每个作物产生了9个地标:虹膜百合体,虹膜上层,虹膜下层,斯克莱拉上层,斯克莱拉下层,中层罐头,横向罐头,盖子上层,盖子下层. 由此产生的标志性探测数据集称为LM-Celeb和LM-CFD。

blocks.en: 4.3 Clinical Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 临床评价数据集

blocks.en: To evaluate clinical domain shift, we use a repository of unlabeled 35,082 external-eye photographs collected over 20 years from a large craniofacial center. These images span diverse conditions affecting the eyes, eyelids, periocular soft tissue, and craniofacial anatomy. This dataset provides a clinically realistic distribution for evaluating whether pretrained representations remain well behaved outside curated public-image settings. This is referred to as Clinic .
blocks.zh: 为了评估临床领域的变化,我们使用一个储存库,储存了20年来从一个大型颅骨中心收集的35,082张无标签的外眼照片。 这些图像覆盖了影响眼睛,眼皮,穿透性软组织,以及颅骨解剖的各种条件. 该数据集提供了一个临床上现实的分布,用于评估在经过精心设计的公共图像设置之外,预先训练的表述是否仍然表现良好。 这被称为诊所。

blocks.en: For disease classification, we constructed a labeled clinical dataset containing 633 diseased-eye images across five disease classes: thyroid eye disease, chalazion, Treacher Collins syndrome, ptosis, and Crouzon/Apert/Pfeiffer syndromes. The 633 images represent a separate dataset collected at a different clinic for which labels were available rather than a deliberate subsample of Clinic . Disease classes were selected because they produce visible periocular or craniofacial findings and are clinically relevant to external-eye assessment. All images were reviewed by an oculoplastic surgery fellow. Images were resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels prior to evaluation. This dataset is used only for downstream five-class disease-classification experiments and is referred to as Disease .
blocks.zh: 在疾病分类方面,我们构建了一个有标签的临床数据集,其中包含633个疾病类的疾病眼影像:甲状腺眼疾病、沙拉齐翁、Treacher Collins综合征、硬化症和Crouzon/Apert/Pfeiffer综合征。 这633幅图片代表着在另一个诊所收集的单独的数据集, 选择疾病类别是因为它们产生可见的腹膜或颅骨检查结果,在临床上与外眼评估相关. 所有图像都经过了一位可塑性外科医生的审查。 图像在评价前被调整为224×224/224\times 224像素. 本数据集仅用于下游的五级疾病分类实验,被称为疾病.

blocks.en: Both clinical datasets were captured during routine clinical care across a wide range of devices and acquisition conditions, resulting in natural variation in lighting, pose, framing, resolution, and background. IRB approval was obtained before use.
blocks.zh: 两个临床数据集都是在各种装置和获取条件的常规临床护理过程中采集的,导致照明、姿势、框架、分辨率和背景的自然变化。 在使用前获得IRB的批准.

blocks.en: 4.4 Release, Licensing, and Intended Use
blocks.zh: 4.4 释放、许可证发放和预期用途

blocks.en: Because SEEC is derived from multiple source datasets with different licensing and use terms, release is organized according to source-specific redistribution provisions (Table 9 ). We will release processed periocular crops for sources whose terms permit redistribution of derived images. For sources for which redistribution is restricted or not expressly permitted, we provide end-to-end tools that allow authorized users to reconstruct the corresponding SEEC resources from the original source datasets.
blocks.zh: 由于SEEC来源于多个源数据集,具有不同的许可和使用条款,所以发布按照特定源的再分配规定(表9 )进行组织. 我们将释放经过加工的过光作物,用于其术语允许重新分配衍生图像的来源。 对于限制或未明确允许再分配的来源,我们提供端对端工具,允许授权用户从原始源数据集重建相应的SEC资源.

blocks.en:
Access to clinical evaluation data may be considered only under appropriate institutional approval, data-use agreements, and ethical review. SEEC is not intended for face recognition or identity verification. Standardized periocular crops reduce full-face exposure but do not completely eliminate privacy or identifiability concerns; source restrictions and intended uses will therefore be documented as part of the release. Code, training pipelines, and evaluation protocols are available here .
All scripts required to reconstruct SEEC can be found here .
blocks.zh:
只有经过适当的机构批准、数据使用协议和道德审查,才能考虑获得临床评价数据。 东南欧合作委员会的目的不是进行脸部识别或身份验证。 标准化的透视作物减少全面接触,但不会完全消除隐私或可识别性关切;因此,来源限制和预期用途将作为释放的一部分记录在案。 这里有代码、培训管道和评价协议。
重建 SEC 所需的所有脚本都可以在这里找到 。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the benchmark tasks. (A) Encoders are pretrained under a controlled self-supervised benchmark strategy. (B) Frozen embeddings are evaluated using geometry metrics across distributions. (C) Frozen embeddings are used for anatomical landmark probing in in-distribution and cross-dataset transfer settings. (D) Disease classification is evaluated using frozen linear probes and five-epoch fine-tuning. For embeddings, border color denotes the evaluation dataset, and fill color denotes the pretraining objective or baseline model.
blocks.zh: 图 2:基准任务概述. (A) 编码器在受控制的自我监督基准战略下进行预先培训。 (B) 使用不同分布的几何度量法评价冻嵌入物。 (C) 冻结嵌入用于解剖地标在分配和跨数据集传输设置中的检测。 (D) 使用冷冻线性探测器和5个世纪的微调来评价疾病分类。 对于嵌入,边框颜色表示评价数据集,填充颜色表示预训目标或基准模型.

blocks.en: 5 Benchmark Task Descriptions
blocks.zh: 5 基准任务说明

blocks.en: We define four benchmark tasks for evaluating external-eye representations: embedding geometry, in-distribution anatomical landmark recovery, out-of-distribution anatomical transfer, and disease classification. Figure 2 summarizes the benchmark design.
blocks.zh: 我们界定了评价外眼表现的四个基准任务:嵌入几何、分布式解剖学里程碑式恢复、分布式解剖学转移和疾病分类。 图2概述了基准设计。

blocks.en: 5.1 Model Setup and Regularizers
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型设置和规范器

blocks.en: We evaluate external-eye self-supervised pretraining using various architectures, objective families, initializations, and pretraining data scales. Models are pretrained on standardized 224 × 224 224\times 224 unilateral external-eye crops from Pretrain-10K , Pretrain-100K , or Pretrain-1M . Unless otherwise noted, downstream evaluations are performed using frozen backbone encoders. For both architectures, we evaluate random initialization and ImageNet initialization in the geometry benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们利用各种结构、客观家庭、初始化和预培训数据尺度,评估外眼自我监督的预培训。 型号在标准化的224×224/224\时224单边外眼作物上经过预先训练,这些作物来自Pretrain-10K,Pretrain-100K,或Pretrain-1M. 除非另有说明,下游评价使用冷冻骨干编码器进行。 对于这两个架构,我们评价几何基准中的随机初始化和ImageNet初始化.

blocks.en: We evaluate two backbone architectures, ResNet-101 and ViT-B/16, under the same 50,000-step training budget. Across architectures, self-supervised training uses a three-layer projection head with hidden dimension 2048 and output dimension 128. The backbone feature dimension is architecture-specific. We compare three representative self-supervised objective families: contrastive learning, redundancy-reduction learning, and JEPA-style predictive learning, instantiated as InfoNCE, VICReg, and LeJEPA, respectively Oord et al. (2018) ; Bardes et al. (2021) ; Balestriero and LeCun (2025) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个骨干结构,即ResNet-101和Vit-B/16,根据同样的5万步培训预算。 在整个架构中,自我监督的训练使用三层投影头,内含隐藏维度2048和输出维度128. 骨干特征层面是建筑特异性的. 我们比较了三个具有代表性的自我监督的客观家庭:对比性学习、减少冗余学习和JEPA式的预测性学习,分别作为InfoNCE、VICReg和LeJEPA(2018年);Bardes等人(2021年);Balestriro和LeCun(2025年)。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Evaluated Objectives
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 评价的目标

blocks.en: To efficiently utilize the representation space, we include regularization functions that impose complementary constraints on paired augmented views and on the projected embedding space while pretraining. InfoNCE Oord et al. (2018) is a contrastive objective that aligns embeddings from two views of the same image while contrasting them against other images in the minibatch using temperature-scaled cosine similarity. VICReg Bardes et al. (2021) combines invariance, variance, and covariance regularization, ℒ VICReg = λ ​ ℒ inv + μ ​ ℒ var + ν ​ ℒ cov , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VICReg}}=\lambda\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{inv}}+\mu\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{var}}+\nu\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cov}}, where the invariance term aligns paired views, the variance term prevents collapse of individual embedding dimensions, and the covariance term penalizes redundancy across dimensions. LeJEPA Balestriero and LeCun (2025) uses a JEPA-style predictive objective with Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SigReg) to prevent representation collapse, ℒ LeJEPA = ( 1 − λ ) ​ ℒ sim + λ ​ ℒ SigReg , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LeJEPA}}=(1-\lambda)\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sim}}+\lambda\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SigReg}}, where the similarity term encourages agreement between paired views and SigReg regularizes the embedding distribution. In our experiments, all objectives are trained using the same two-view augmentation protocol to allow for fair comparisons across methods. Please see Appendix C.1 for implementation details of the objectives and training settings considered.

blocks.en: To evaluate whether pretrained external-eye representations encode disease-relevant structure, we perform five-class disease classification on Disease using ResNet-101 and ViT-B/16 encoders initialized randomly prior to self-supervised pretraining on Pretrain-1M . The dataset was divided into an 80/20 train/test split using a fixed random seed and stratification by disease class. Splits were grouped at the image level, such that all crops derived from the same source image were assigned to the same partition in order to prevent leakage.
blocks.zh: 为了评估事先受过训练的外眼表现是否编码疾病相关结构,我们使用ResNet-101和ViT-B/16编码器在自行监督的Pretrain-1M预训前随机初始化,对疾病进行五级疾病分类。 数据集分为80/20次列车/测试分型,使用固定随机种子和按疾病等级分型. 在图像级别上对分割进行分组,这样,所有来自同一源图像的作物都被分配到同一分区,以防止渗漏。

blocks.en: For each encoder, we first evaluate frozen representation quality using a linear probe. Frozen and fine-tuned models are evaluated on the same grouped held-out test split.

blocks.en: 6.2 Analysis of Embedding Geometry

blocks.en: We first analyzed the geometry of the learned projected representation spaces using effective rank normalized by embedding dimension ( r eff / D r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D ) across Holdout , Open-HR , and Clinic (Figure 3 ). Across both ResNet-101 and ViT-B/16, LeJEPA produced the highest r eff / D r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D among the evaluated self-supervised objectives, indicating broader use of the available projected embedding dimensions. For ResNet-101, the strongest LeJEPA configurations reached r eff / D = 0.72 r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D=0.72 on Holdout , 0.55 0.55 on Open-HR , and 0.44 0.44 on Clinic . For ViT-B/16, LeJEPA also achieved the highest effective rank on each distribution, reaching r eff / D = 0.73 r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D=0.73 on Holdout , 0.20 0.20 on Open-HR , and 0.12 0.12 on Clinic .

blocks.en: Additionally, distribution shift substantially affected representation geometry. Although the relative ordering of objective families was broadly stable, the magnitude of separation varied across Holdout , Open-HR , and Clinic . All objectives showed reduced r eff / D r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D under distribution shift, with the largest reductions on Clinic . This effect was especially pronounced for ViT-B/16, where projected representations that were comparatively high-rank on Holdout became much lower-rank on the clinically shifted distribution. These results indicate that geometry conclusions drawn from source-matched data do not transfer unchanged to external or clinical settings.
blocks.zh: 此外,分配变化严重影响了代表几何。 尽管客观家庭的相对顺序大体稳定,但不同Holdout、Open-HR和Clinic的分离程度各不相同。 所有目标都显示,在分配转变中, r eff / D r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D 减少, 诊所的减少幅度最大。 这种影响在Vit-B/16中特别明显,在Holdout上排名相对较高的预测表述在临床转变的分布中排名低得多。 这些结果表明,从来源匹配的数据中得出的几何学结论不会无改变地转移到外部或临床环境.

blocks.en: Initialization also affected embedding-space utilization. Randomly initialized models generally produced higher-rank projected embeddings than ImageNet-initialized models, particularly for InfoNCE and VICReg on Open-HR and Clinic . Together, these results show that embedding geometry is sensitive to objective family, initialization, architecture, and evaluation distribution. We therefore interpret r eff / D r_{\mathrm{eff}}/D as a representation-level diagnostic, while downstream anatomical and disease-relevant utility are evaluated separately in the following sections. Additional geometry metrics demonstrated consistent trends; further evaluation of these is provided in Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en: 6.3 Anatomical Landmark Probes

blocks.en: We next evaluated whether frozen representations preserve anatomically meaningful external-eye structure using landmark prediction probes on LM-Celeb and LM-CFD . We report both in-distribution performance, where probes were trained and evaluated on splits from the same landmark dataset, and out-of-distribution performance, where probes were trained on LM-Celeb and evaluated on LM-CFD (Figure 2 C).
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们利用LM-Celeb和LM-CFD的标志性预测探测器,评估冻结的表示是否保留了解剖意义外眼结构。 我们既报告分配性能,即对探测器从同一具有里程碑意义的数据集分解进行训练和评价,又报告分配外性能,即对探测器进行LM-Celeb培训和对LM-CFD(图2 C)进行评价。

blocks.en: 6.3.1 In-Distribution

Across both encoder families, self-supervised external-eye pretraining substantially improved landmark recovery relative to initialization-only baselines. This effect was observed for both LM-Celeb (Figure 4 ) and LM-CFD (Figure 10 ), indicating that the learned representations preserve spatial information relevant for anatomical recovery on both datasets evaluated. Performance generally improved with increasing pretraining scale, although the best objective varied across dataset, architecture, and initialization. ResNet-101 and ViT-B encoders both reached low mean landmark error after pretraining, with ViT-B/16 models achieving slightly lower errors overall.
blocks.zh: 在两个编码家庭,自我监督的外眼前培训大大改善了与初始化基线相比的标志性恢复。 对LM-Celeb(图4)和LM-CFD(图10)都观察到了这种影响,表明学到的表示方法保存了两个评价数据集中与解剖恢复有关的空间信息。 绩效一般随着培训前规模的扩大而得到改善,尽管最佳目标在数据集、结构和初始化方面各不相同。 ResNet-101和ViT-B编码器在预训后都达到了低平均值的地标错误,而ViT-B/16模型总体实现的误差略低.

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Out-of-Distribution
blocks.zh: 6.3.2 国家 分散

blocks.en: In the out-of-distribution task, among ResNet-101 encoders, random-initialized VICReg achieved the lowest overall error (mean L2 = 4.94 =4.94 ), followed by random-initialized LeJEPA (mean L2 = 5.16 =5.16 ). ViT-B/16 encoders performed better overall, with random-initialized InfoNCE achieving the lowest mean L2 and mean MAE across all evaluated encoders (mean L2 = 4.24 =4.24 , mean MAE = 2.65 =2.65 ; Table 2 ). Random-initialized ViT-B/16 LeJEPA achieved the lowest medial and lateral canthus errors.
blocks.zh: 在分配外任务中,ResNet-101编码器中,随机初始化的VICReg实现了最小的整体错误(平均L2 = 4.94 = 4.94),其次是随机初始化的LeJEPA(平均L2 = 5.16 = 5.16). VIT-B/16编码器总体性能较好,随机初始化的InfoNCE在所有被评价编码器中实现了最低的平均值L2和平均MAE(平均L2=4.24=4.24,平均MAE=2.65=2.65;表2). 随机初始化的VIT-B/16 LeJEPA实现了最低的介质和横向的Canthus错误.

blocks.en: Domain-specific external-eye pretraining was superior to the general-purpose ViT foundation-model baselines in the cross-dataset landmark transfer setting. The best external-eye-pretrained ViT encoders outperformed both DINOv2 and MAE on mean L2, mean MAE, iris centroid error, medial canthus error, and lateral canthus error. Thus, despite being trained at substantially smaller scale than DINOv2, domain-specific external-eye ViT-B/16 pretraining produced representations that were more useful for cross-dataset periocular landmark transfer. Figure 5 provides qualitative examples of landmark predictions for representative out-of-distribution models.
blocks.zh: 特定域的外眼预训优于跨数据集地标转移设置中的通用VIT基础模型基线. 最佳的外眼预导ViT编码器在平均L2,平均MAE,虹膜中间行星错误,介质罐头错误,以及横向罐头错误上都超过了DINOv2和MAE. 因此,尽管培训的规模大大小于DINOv2,但针对特定领域外部眼的VIT-B/16预训产生了更有助于跨数据集地标转让的说明。 图5提供了具有代表性的分配外模型的标志性预测的定性实例。

blocks.en: 6.4 Disease Classification Probe
blocks.zh: 6.4 疾病分类

blocks.en: We next evaluated whether pretrained representations support disease classification from external-eye images using frozen linear probing and short-horizon supervised adaptation (Figure 2 D).
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们通过冷冻线性探测和短视监督适应(图2 D),评价预先训练的表述是否支持从外眼图像中进行疾病分类。

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Frozen Probe
blocks.zh: 6.4.1 冻结探测器

blocks.en: In the frozen linear-probe setting, external-eye-pretrained ViT-B/16 models performed strongest overall (Table 3 ). ViT-B/16 InfoNCE achieved the highest accuracy, recall, and F1, while ViT-B/16 VICReg was the second-best model across all three metrics. DINOv2 was a strong general-purpose baseline, matching LeJEPA in accuracy and F1, but remained below the best external-eye-pretrained ViT-B/16 models. MAE and all ResNet-101 models performed lower overall. These results indicate that disease-relevant information is linearly recoverable from external-eye-pretrained ViT-B/16 representations and that transformer-scale external-eye pretraining improves frozen disease separability relative to the corresponding ResNet-101 encoders.
blocks.zh: 在冷冻的线性探测设定中,外眼预导的VIT-B/16模型总体表现最强(表3 ). VIT-B/16 InfoNCE实现了最高的准确度,召回,和F1,而VIT-B/16 VICReg则是所有三个度量衡的第二最佳模型. DINOv2是一个很强的通用基线,在准确性和F1方面与LeJEPA相匹配,但仍低于最佳的外眼预导VIT-B/16型号. MAE和所有ResNet-101型号的总体表现较低。 这些结果表明,与疾病有关的信息可以从外部受前导的ViT-B/16表达中线性恢复,变压器规模的外导前导与对应的ResNet-101编码器相比,提高了冷冻性疾病分解性.

blocks.en: Table 3: Disease classification performance on held-out external-eye images using frozen linear probes and five-epoch joint training of the full backbone and linear classifier. Accuracy, F1, and recall are reported on the held-out test set; F1 and recall are averaged across disease classes. Bold and italics indicate best and second best respectively for each experimental setting.
blocks.zh: 表3:利用冷冻线性探测器和全骨干和线性分类器的5个划时代联合训练,对持有的外眼图像进行疾病分类性能. F1精确度和召回率在停产测试中报告;F1和召回率在疾病类别中平均。 粗体和斜体分别表示每个实验环境的最佳和第二佳。

blocks.en: 6.4.2 Joint Training Encoder and Probe
blocks.zh: 6.4.2 联合培训编码器和探测器

blocks.en: After five epochs of supervised adaptation, ViT-B/16 models again outperformed ResNet-101 models. ViT-B/16 VICReg achieved the strongest performance among external-eye-pretrained models, while InfoNCE and LeJEPA remained close. MAE also adapted well, matching the highest accuracy and F1 and achieving the highest recall in the five-epoch setting. In contrast, DINOv2 performed poorly after fine-tuning despite strong frozen-probe performance, suggesting that frozen separability does not necessarily predict short-horizon adaptation behavior. The ResNet-101 models remained below the ViT-B/16 models across objectives.
blocks.zh: 经过5个时代的有监督的改造,VIT-B/16型号再次超过了ResNet-101型号. ViT-B/16 ViCREG在外视预导模型中取得了最强的性能,而InfoNCE和LeJEPA则保持紧密. MAE也进行了很好的调整,匹配了最高的精确度和F1,并在五个时代的设定中实现了最高的召回. 相比之下,DINOv2在微调后尽管有强烈的冷冻探测性能却表现不佳,这表明冷冻分离性并不一定预测短视的适应行为. ResNet-101模式仍低于Vit-B/16模式,贯穿所有目标。

blocks.en: Qualitative t-SNE visualizations of fine-tuned embeddings showed disease-labeled structure in the adapted representation space (Figure 6 ). MAE produced visually tighter local clusters, although some disease labels appeared split across multiple regions, while VICReg produced a more diffuse embedding with less apparent within-class fragmentation.
blocks.zh: 微调嵌入物的定性t-SNE可视化显示在调整后的表达空间中存在带有疾病标签的结构(图6 ). MAE产生了视觉上更紧凑的局部集群,尽管一些疾病标签似乎在多个区域之间分裂,而VICReg则产生了一种比较分散的嵌入,在类内分化不太明显。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results demonstrate that classification of diseases affecting the external eye is sensitive to both architecture and objective family with external-eye-pretrained ViT-B/16 encoders providing the strongest overall disease-relevant representations compared to baselines.
blocks.zh: 综合这些结果表明,对影响外眼的疾病进行分类对结构和客观家族都具有敏感性,与基线相比,外眼前置的VIT-B/16编码器提供了最强的与疾病相关的整体表述。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: External-eye photographs are increasingly used for clinical classification, anatomical analysis, and oculomics, yet most prior external-eye AI studies remain supervised and task-specific, while ophthalmic foundation-model efforts have largely focused on retinal or device-based imaging Hung et al. (2021) ; Shu et al. (2024) ; Abascal Azanza et al. (2023) ; Karlin et al. (2023) ; Moon et al. (2022) ; Alkhadrawi et al. (2024) ; Han et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2022) ; Lee et al. (2023) ; Hui et al. (2025) ; Zhou et al. (2023) ; Chia et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2025) . Existing periocular datasets have similarly been developed primarily for iris recognition, periocular biometrics, or specialized acquisition settings rather than for learning general-purpose representations Proena and Alexandre (2005) ; Proenca et al. (2010) ; Padole and Proenca (2012) ; Zanlorensi et al. (2022) ; Nguyen et al. (2021) ; Tiong et al. (2019) ; Fuhl et al. (2021) . Consequently, most existing systems learn features for a single predefined task and provide limited evidence that those features capture reusable anatomical or clinical information that transfers across datasets, acquisition settings, or downstream endpoints. This limitation is particularly relevant as external-eye imaging is increasingly explored as a low-cost source of clinically informative phenotypes, including biomarkers of systemic health in oculomics. Progress in this setting depends not only on task-specific classifiers, but on representations that capture transferable anatomical and clinically relevant structure across datasets and acquisition domains. We address this gap with a standardized external-eye corpus and benchmark spanning embedding geometry, anatomical landmark recovery, cross-dataset anatomical transfer, and disease classification.
blocks.zh: 外眼照片越来越多地用于临床分类、解剖分析以及闭路生物学,但以前大多数外眼AI研究仍然受到监督并有特定任务,而眼球基础模型工作主要侧重于视网膜或基于装置的成像Hung等人(2021);Shu等人(2024);Abascal Azanza等人(2023);Karlin等人(2023);Moon等人(2022);Alkhadrawi等人(2024);Han等人(2025);Li等人(2022);Lee等人(2023); Hui等人(2025年);Zhou等人(2023年);Chia等人(2024年);Zhu等人(2025年)。 现有的透视数据集也主要用于虹膜识别、透视生物鉴别或专门获取环境,而不是用于学习普罗埃纳和亚历山大(2005年);普罗恩卡等人(2010年);帕多勒和普罗恩卡(2012年);赞洛伦西等人(2022年);阮等人(2021年);蒂翁等人(2019年);富尔等人(2021年)。 因此,大多数现有系统都为单一预先确定的任务学习特征,并提供了有限的证据,证明这些特征能够捕捉可重复使用的解剖或临床信息,从而跨越数据集、获取设置或下游终点进行传输。 这一局限性特别相关,因为人们越来越多地将外眼成像作为临床信息素类的低成本来源加以探索,包括八溴环十二烷系统健康的生物标志。 这一背景下的进展不仅取决于具体任务分类器,还取决于能够捕捉跨数据集和获取领域的可转移解剖和临床相关结构的表示。 我们通过标准化的外视体和基准来弥补这一差距,包括嵌入几何、解剖学里程碑式恢复、跨数据集解剖学转移和疾病分类。

blocks.en:
A central contribution of SEEC is the conversion of heterogeneous facial-image
resources into a standardized external-eye pretraining corpus. Although the resulting pretraining corpus is derived primarily from public facial-image datasets rather than prospectively collected clinical photographs, this design provides scale and acquisition diversity that are difficult to obtain from clinical cohorts alone. Importantly, the benchmark explicitly evaluates whether representations learned from these public-source images transfer to clinically acquired external-eye photographs through both the Clinic geometry analysis and the independent Disease classification task. The substantial changes in representation geometry observed on Clinic , together with preserved downstream disease classification performance, emphasize that clinical domain shift is a property to be measured rather than assumed away.
blocks.zh:
SEEC的一个中心贡献是转换 异形面部图像
将资源纳入标准化的外视预培训大纲。 虽然由此产生的预训程序主要来自公共面部图像数据集,而不是预期收集的临床照片,但这种设计提供了规模和获取的多样性,仅从临床人群中很难获得。 重要的是,该基准通过临床几何分析和独立的疾病分类任务,明确评价从这些公共来源图像中获取的表述是否转移到临床获得的外眼照片。 临床上观察到的表达几何学的重大变化,以及保存的下游疾病分类性能,都强调临床域位移是一个要测量而不是假设的属性.

blocks.en: More broadly, our findings show that embedding geometry and downstream utility are related but not interchangeable. Effective rank provides a useful representation-level diagnostic for embedding-space utilization and distribution shift, but anatomical recovery, anatomical transfer, and disease separability require dedicated functional probes. This is reflected by the difference in model rankings across benchmark axes. For example, LeJEPA produced the highest-rank projected embedding spaces, but did not dominate all anatomical or disease-classification probes, while ViT encoders trained with InfoNCE or VICReg achieved stronger performance on specific landmark and classification tasks. Our work also demonstrates that domain-specific external-eye pretraining can encode periocular structure not fully captured by general-purpose visual foundation models. In cross-dataset landmark transfer, the best external-eye-pretrained ViT encoders outperformed DINOv2 and MAE across aggregate and regional landmark metrics despite being trained at substantially smaller scale Oquab et al. (2023) ; He et al. (2022) . In disease classification, external-eye-pretrained ViT encoders achieved the strongest frozen-probe performance and remained competitive after short-horizon supervised adaptation.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果表明,嵌入几何学和下游用途是相互关联的,但不可互换。 有效的排名为嵌入空间利用和分布转移提供了一个有用的代表级别诊断,但解剖恢复,解剖转移,以及疾病分离需要专门的功能探测器. 不同基准轴的模型排名的差异反映了这一点。 例如,LeJEPA生产了排名最高的预计嵌入空间,但并不主导所有解剖或疾病分类探测器,而经过InfoNCE或VICReg培训的ViT编码器在具体的地标和分类任务上取得了更强的性能. 我们的工作还表明,针对域的外眼预训可以编码透视结构,但一般目的视觉基础模型不能完全捕捉到. 在跨数据集的划时代转移中,最好的外眼预导维T编码器在总体和区域划时代的衡量标准上都超过了DINOv2和MAE,尽管在Oquab等人(2023年)的培训规模要小得多;He等人(2022年)。 在疾病分类中,外眼预导的ViT编码器实现了最强的冷冻探测性能,并在短视监督适应后保持竞争力.

blocks.en: Taken together, external-eye photography is low-cost, accessible by any modern smartphone, and commonly obtained during routine clinical documentation Babenko et al. (2022) . Furthermore, recent work suggests that external-eye photographs may provide clues into systemic biology, which has implications far beyond screening for disease that affects the external eye Babenko et al. (2022) ; Babenko et al. (2023) . Realizing this potential will require representations that preserve periocular anatomy, generalize across acquisition settings, and support numerous downstream tasks. The benchmark introduced here provides a foundation for this work by standardizing external-eye pretraining resources, evaluation distributions, anatomical probes, and clinical classification tasks. We hope this resource lowers the barrier to entry for external-eye representation learning and supports broader investigation of the externally visible eye as a scalable modality for medical computer vision.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,外眼摄影成本低廉,任何现代智能手机都可以使用,通常在常规临床文献Babenko等人(2022年)中获得. 此外,最近的研究表明,外眼照片可能为系统生物学提供线索,其影响远远超出对影响外眼的疾病Babenko等人(2022年);Babenko等人(2023年)。 要实现这一潜力,就必须作出说明,保存腹膜解剖学,将采购环境普遍化,并支持许多下游任务。 这里引入的基准通过将外眼前训练资源,评价分布,解剖探测器,临床分类任务标准化,为这项工作提供了基础. 我们希望,这一资源将减少进入外部眼界学习的障碍,支持更广泛地调查外部可见眼作为医疗计算机视觉的可伸缩模式。

Points represent external-eye images and are colored by disease class. t-SNE is shown for qualitative visualization only; quantitative comparisons are based on held-out classification metrics in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 图6:经过监督微调后,对带有疾病标签的嵌入物进行定性可视化. T-SNE的预测显示为MAE和VICREG VIT-B编码器,此前对疾病分类任务进行了5个时期的微调. 点代表外眼影像,并按疾病类配色. t-SNE仅用于定性可视化;定量比较基于表3中的搁置分类度量。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: We have identified several limitations from our work. First , the clinical evaluations are limited in scope. Disease contains 633 images across five oculoplastic and craniofacial disease classes and was evaluated using source-image-level grouping rather than confirmed patient-level separation because patient-level identifiers were unavailable. In addition, the clinical domain-shift and disease datasets are not publicly released due to institutional and ethical restrictions, although access may be considered under appropriate institutional review and data-use agreements. More broadly, complete reproduction of all benchmark components is constrained by source-specific licensing and clinical data-use restrictions. Where direct redistribution is not permitted, we provide manifests and reconstruction tools rather than the processed images themselves. Second , the anatomical probe evaluates a defined subset of periocular structure. Landmark targets were deterministically derived from previously annotated segmentation masks and comprise nine iris, scleral, canthal, and eyelid landmarks across two probe datasets. Although this provides a reproducible measure of anatomical recovery, it does not capture the full range of potentially relevant periocular morphology. Finally , qualitative visualization and short-horizon adaptation results should not be overinterpreted. In our t-SNE results (Figure 6 ), we observed overlap between some disease classes which suggests that there was not full separation of all classes. Additionally, after five-epoch supervised adaptation, ResNet-101 models lost performance on disease classification, and DINOv2, despite strong frozen-probe performance, degraded substantially under fine-tuning. ResNet-101 degradation likely reflects insufficient capacity to adapt under a small labeled set, while DINOv2’s collapse despite strong frozen performance may reflect optimization sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们查明了我们工作中的几个局限性。 第一,临床评价的范围有限。 疾病包含633幅图片,涵盖5种可塑性和颅骨病类别,通过来源-图像级分组而非确认的患者一级隔离进行评估,因为没有患者一级识别资料。 此外,由于体制和道德方面的限制,临床域位转移和疾病数据集没有公开发布,尽管根据适当的机构审查和数据使用协议可以考虑获取。 更广泛地说,所有基准组成部分的完整复制受到特定来源许可证和临床数据使用限制的限制。 在不允许直接重新分配的地方,我们提供清单和重建工具,而不是经过处理的图像本身。 其次,解剖探测器评价了一个定义的子集的透视结构. 地标目标从先前附加说明的分块口罩中得出决定性结果,由9个虹膜、支脉、峡谷和眼皮地标组成,跨越两个探测数据集。 尽管这为解剖学的恢复提供了可复制的衡量标准,但它并没有捕捉到所有可能相关的腹腔形态. 最后,定性可视化和短期适应结果不应被过度解释。 在T-SNE结果(图6)中,我们看到一些疾病类别之间的重叠,这表明并非所有类别都完全分离。 此外,经过五个世纪的监管调整后,ResNet-101模型在疾病分类方面丧失了性能,而DINOv2模型尽管性能很强,但经过微调后严重退化。 ResNet-101的降解可能反映了在小的标签集下适应能力不足,而DINov2的崩溃尽管有强烈的冷冻性能,却可能反映了优化敏感性.

blocks.en: Several extensions follow naturally from our work. Our controlled pretraining experiments use a limited two-view setup to maintain comparability across objective families; future work should evaluate whether richer local/global multi-view training Balestriero and LeCun (2025) , longer pretraining schedules, and larger models further improve performance. In addition, the disease classification probe is intentionally standardized rather than optimized for maximum supervised performance. Future work should evaluate stronger adaptation protocols using larger labeled datasets, and investigate the different adaptation behavior observed across architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作自然会延长几个期限。 未来的工作应该评价更丰富的本地/全球多景培训Balestriero和LeCun(2025年), 较长的预训计划以及更大的模式是否进一步提高绩效。 此外,疾病分类探测器被有意标准化,而不是优化以达到最大监督性能. 今后的工作应当使用更大的标注数据集来评价更强的适应协议,并调查整个架构观察到的不同适应行为.

blocks.en: Broader Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en: SEEC is intended to support development and evaluation of general-purpose external-eye representations using inexpensive visible-light imaging. More capable and reusable representations of external-eye anatomy could facilitate research on accessible ophthalmic screening, phenotyping, and oculomics, particularly in settings where specialized imaging equipment is unavailable. We also hope that the standardized corpus and benchmark will improve reproducibility by providing common data-processing and evaluation procedures for tasks in external-eye representation learning.
blocks.zh: 东南欧合作委员会旨在支持利用廉价可见光成像开发和评价通用外眼表示。 更有能力和可重复使用的外眼解剖方法可以促进关于可获取的眼科筛查、麻黄和闭路生物的研究,特别是在没有专门成像设备的情况下。 我们还希望,标准化的教程和基准将改善可复制性,为外眼代表性学习的任务提供共同的数据处理和评价程序。

blocks.en: These potential benefits are accompanied by important risks. Periocular images remain potentially identifiable, and models trained on public face datasets may inherit demographic, acquisition, or sampling biases that are not fully characterized in SEEC. Representations learned from these data could also be repurposed for unintended applications such as identity recognition or used clinically without adequate external validation, potentially producing unreliable or inequitable results. As such, SEEC is not intended for face recognition, identity verification, or direct clinical deployment without appropriate external validation and oversight.
blocks.zh: 这些潜在好处伴随着重大风险。 外观图像仍然有可能被识别,在公共脸谱数据集方面接受过培训的模型可能继承了在SEC中没有完全特征的人口、获取或抽样偏差。 从这些数据中吸取的表述也可以重新用于身份识别等意想不到的应用,或者在临床上使用,而没有充分的外部验证,可能产生不可靠或不公平的结果. 因此,SEEC的目的不是在没有适当的外部验证和监督的情况下进行面部识别、身份验证或直接临床部署。

blocks.en: SEEC (Standardized External-Eye Corpus) is a large-scale external-eye/periocular image corpus developed for representation learning and benchmarking tasks related to the external eye. The corpus contains 4,352,692 unilateral 224 × \times 224 periocular crops derived from 14 public face-image datasets, together with a 134,969-image high-resolution subset at 512 × \times 512. Counts refer to images rather than unique individuals.

blocks.en: Corpus construction included deduplication, face detection and alignment, manual periocular quality annotation, dataset-specific CNN filtering, bilateral periocular cropping, left/right splitting, and resizing. blocks.en: B.3 Benchmark use
blocks.zh: B.3 基准使用情况

blocks.en: The SEEC benchmark evaluates learned representations across four settings: embedding geometry under distribution shift, anatomical landmark recovery, cross-dataset anatomical transfer, and disease classification using frozen probes and short supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: SEEC基准评价了四个环境的学习表现:在分布转变下嵌入几何,解剖里程碑恢复,交叉数据集解剖转移,以及使用冷冻探测器和短期监督微调进行疾病分类.

blocks.en: Public benchmark resources are intended to support representation-learning research, model comparison, and reproducibility studies involving external-eye and periocular images.
blocks.zh: 公共基准资源旨在支持表现学习研究、模型比较和涉及外视和透视图像的可复制性研究。

blocks.en: B.5 Intended use, limitations, and human data
blocks.zh: B.5 联合国 预定用途、限制和人类数据

blocks.en: SEEC is intended to support research on external-eye and periocular representation learning and benchmarking. Its primary use is as a standardized substrate for studying whether models trained on large-scale external-eye imagery learn anatomical and clinically relevant representations that transfer across datasets and tasks.
blocks.zh: 东南欧合作委员会旨在支持外视和透视表现学习和基准研究。 其主要用途是作为一个标准化的底物,用于研究接受大规模外视图像培训的模型是否学习跨数据集和任务的解剖学和临床相关表述。

blocks.en: SEEC is derived from previously released face-image datasets rather than from direct collection of new public-subject data by the SEEC authors. Collection procedures, consent mechanisms, demographic composition, and original terms therefore differ across source datasets and should be interpreted according to the documentation provided by the respective dataset creators.
blocks.zh: SEEC来源于之前发布的面像数据集,而不是由SEEC作者直接收集新的公共主体数据. 因此,收集程序、同意机制、人口组成和原始术语在不同源数据集之间有所不同,应根据各自数据集创建者提供的文件加以解释。

blocks.en: Because SEEC combines images from heterogeneous public face datasets, its scale should not be interpreted as evidence of demographic or clinical representativeness. Periocular cropping removes much of the surrounding facial context but does not guarantee anonymity or eliminate the possibility of identification. SEEC does not provide a harmonized demographic characterization or validated subject-level metadata across the combined corpus.
blocks.zh: 由于SEEC结合了不同公共脸谱数据集的图像,其规模不应被解释为人口或临床代表性的证据. 腹部收割可以消除周围的大部分面部上下文,但并不能保证匿名或消除识别的可能性. 东南欧合作委员会没有提供统一的人口特征或经核实的综合主体一级元数据。

blocks.en: The accompanying clinical evaluations are intended to assess representation quality rather than establish deployment-ready clinical performance. The Clinic and Disease datasets are restricted and are not publicly distributed. SEEC is not intended for face recognition, identity verification, or direct clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 所附的临床评价旨在评估表现质量,而不是确定可部署的临床表现。 临床和疾病数据集受到限制,不公开分发。 SEEC不是用于脸部识别、身份验证或直接临床部署。

blocks.en: The predictive baseline uses LeJEPA, a JEPA-style objective operating on paired augmented views of the same image Balestriero and LeCun (2025) . Given two views, the encoder and projector produce view-specific embeddings, and training encourages these embeddings to agree while preventing representational collapse. In the benchmark configuration used in this paper, the collapse-prevention term is the sliced Gaussian regularizer SigReg Balestriero and LeCun (2025) .

blocks.en: Let ℒ sim \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sim}} denote the predictive similarity term between paired projected views, and let ℒ SigReg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SigReg}} denote the SigReg regularizer. blocks.en: For each frozen encoder, embeddings were extracted from LM-Celeb and LM-CFD using the fixed image preprocessing pipeline described in Section 5.3 . The encoder weights were held fixed for all landmark experiments. For ResNet-101 models, features were extracted from the frozen backbone feature map. We evaluated global average pooling and 4 × 4 4\times 4 adaptive grid pooling. For ViT models, patch tokens were reshaped into spatial feature maps and pooled using the same 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid-pooling procedure.
blocks.zh: 每个冷冻编码器都使用第5.3节所述的固定图像预处理管道从LM-Celeb和LM-CFD中提取嵌入物。 编码器的重量被固定 用于所有标志性的实验。 对于ResNet-101型号,从冻结的主干功能图中提取了特性. 我们评价了全球平均集合 和4×4 4\时4个适应性电网集合。 对于ViT模型,补丁符号被重塑成空间特征图,并采用相同的4×4 4\times 4网格集合程序进行集合.

blocks.en: The landmark probe was implemented as a multilayer perceptron with hidden dimensions 1024 and 512 and dropout 0.2. The probe predicted 18 output values corresponding to ( x , y ) (x,y) coordinates for nine landmarks: iris centroid, iris superior, iris inferior, sclera superior, sclera inferior, medial canthus, lateral canthus, lid superior, and lid inferior. Probes were trained with AdamW using learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} for up to 1000 epochs, with early stopping based on validation mean landmark Euclidean error.
blocks.zh: 该标志性探测器作为多层透视器被执行,其隐藏尺寸为1024和512,退出0.2. 探测器预测了对应于(x,y)(x,y)坐标的18个输出值,用于9个地标:虹膜中间体,虹膜上层,虹膜下层,sclera上层,sclera下层,Medial Canthus,横向罐头,盖层上层,盖层下层. 探测器与AdamW一起接受了训练,使用学习率10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 )和体重衰变率10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4 ),最多达1000个纪元,早期停止基于验证的标志性欧几利得误差.

blocks.en: We report mean absolute error and mean Euclidean error over landmarks. For each sample and landmark, Euclidean error was computed in pixel units on the 224 × \times 224 crop coordinate system. Within-dataset evaluation used fixed train, validation, and test splits from the same source dataset. Cross-dataset transfer used the LM-Celeb training and validation splits for probe fitting and model selection, followed by evaluation on the LM-CFD test split without retraining or further adaptation.

blocks.en: In addition to normalized effective rank, we evaluated complementary geometry diagnostics based on spectral concentration and pairwise angular dispersion (Figure 8 and 9 ). These analyses support the same qualitative conclusions as the main-text effective-rank results. Across architectures and evaluation distributions, LeJEPA generally produced lower top-20 explained variance, indicating that variance was less concentrated in the leading covariance directions. Conversely, VICReg and some InfoNCE configurations showed higher top-20 explained variance, consistent with more anisotropic projected embedding spaces.
blocks.zh: 除了正常的有效排名外,我们还根据光谱浓度和双向角散射评估了辅助几何诊断(图8和图9)。 这些分析支持与主文有效排序结果相同的定性结论。 在整个架构和评价分布中,LeJEPA一般都产生较低前20级的差异,说明差异较少集中在主要的共变方向。 反之,VICReg和一些InfoNCE的配置显示较高的前20位解释差异,与较异构的预测嵌入空间一致.

blocks.en: Pairwise cosine dispersion showed a similar pattern. After centering and row-normalizing projected embeddings, LeJEPA generally produced lower cosine standard deviation than InfoNCE or VICReg, indicating less angular concentration among samples. The separation between objectives was most apparent under distribution shift, particularly on Clinic , where several configurations exhibited increased spectral and angular concentration.
blocks.zh: 对等余弦散射显示类似模式. LeJEPA在将预测的嵌入物中心化和行规范化后,一般产生比InfoNCE或VICReg更低的余弦标准偏差,表明在样本中的角浓度较低. 目标之间的分离在分配转变中最为明显,特别是在诊所,若干配置显示光谱和角浓度增加。
